//: Copy to config.json (or pass --config <file>) and keep only what you change. Every key is optional; unknown keys are an error. Secrets can come from the environment instead (see README).

server.//: Bind to loopback and put a TLS reverse proxy in front. basePath is the public path, e.g. /command-center/.

auth.//: password: built-in sign-in (first run prints a generated password; change it with npm run set-password). proxy: your reverse proxy already authenticated the user. none: loopback only, for development.

gateway.//: The token is read from ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json (gateway.auth.token) when not set here or in OPENCLAW_GATEWAY_TOKEN. Off loopback the app pairs as a device: approve it with openclaw devices approve <id>.

assistant.//: The OpenClaw session that typed and spoken turns go to. The name defaults to that agent's identity.

ui.//: timeZone: IANA zone for every clock and time on screen (default: the browser's). controlUiUrl: your OpenClaw Control UI, for deep links.
suggestions: What’s running on the gateway right now?
What did I miss in my channels?
How much have I used today?

talk.//: Realtime voice through the gateway's Talk (WebRTC). Needs a realtime voice provider configured in OpenClaw.

native.//: Exec, plugin and system approvals from the gateway's own approval queue.

files.//: Optional: approval requests your agent writes as markdown files (<dir>/<YYYYMMDD>-<n>.md). A decision is sent to the agent as a chat message in its own session.

google.//: Optional calendar and inbox panels through the gog CLI (OpenClaw's Google Workspace skill). command is the argv prefix used to run it.

host.//: Memory, disk, load and gateway RSS of the machine this server runs on. Turn off when it isn't the gateway host.
